title: Licences
intro: {{app}} is built on openly licensed data, drawings, fonts and software. These are the people and projects behind them, and the terms we use their work under.

wger.title: wger exercise database
wger.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 / 4.0 or CC0, per exercise
wger.note: Exercise names, descriptions, muscles and equipment. Mapped onto the app's muscle and equipment names; Turkish text is a machine translation where an exercise says so. Each exercise credits its own source.

workoutGuide.title: workout-guide illustrations
workoutGuide.holder: Bryl Lim; 76 drawings traced from Everkinetic
workoutGuide.note: Three-frame movement drawings, recoloured to the app theme and played as a flipbook.

muscles.title: Muscle diagrams
muscles.note: Based on the "Muscular system" drawing. Recoloured: worked muscles are painted in the app's accent.

usda.title: USDA FoodData Central
usda.holder: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service
usda.note: Cite as: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central. fdc.nal.usda.gov. Turkish food names are our machine translation.

off.title: Open Food Facts
off.note: Packaged product search. Values are shown as published there; not for medical use.
